### Instruction: Convert this book excerpt into a Fountain-format screenplay. ### Book: The rain lashed against the windows of the old mansion. Arthur paced the study, his footsteps echoing on the oak floor. 'It's gone,' he whispered to the empty room. ### Screenplay: INT. OLD MANSION - STUDY - NIGHT

Rain LASHES against the windows.

ARTHUR paces the study. His footsteps ECHO on the oak floor.

ARTHUR
(whispering)
It's gone.
